sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(trim(coalesce(generic_name, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:[0-9.,]+ ?%?[^a-z0-9-]+)?(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free)[^a-z0-9-]+)*ifosfamide(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[^a-z0-9-].*)' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc
